question: What is the pettiest revenge you ever pulled on a neighbor?
story: My neighbor towed my car out of my own driveway, so I got a city bus stop installed in front of his house. His name was Gary. Gary believed the street belonged to him because he had lived there the longest. He measured things. He owned a laser level. When I parked eleven inches into what he called his zone, he called a tow truck and had my car hauled away while I was asleep. Two hundred and forty dollars. Here is where he lost. Our city had an open portal for transit requests, and our block had been flagged for years as underserved. I filled out one form. I attached photos. I wrote three very polite paragraphs about accessibility. Six months later a crew showed up with a concrete pad and a bench. Gary now has a bus stop, a shelter, and eleven strangers sitting in his zone every morning. I have my driveway.
